notes.title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business is out now!
notes.notes:
[p][b]July 17th, 1987:[/b] the first RoboCop movie is released in theatres. [/p][p][b]July 17th, 2025:[/b] 38 years later, RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business launches with Peter Weller reprising his role as RoboCop.  

The OmniTower awaits! An OCP housing project turned deadly fortress by a group of mercenaries who seized control of the facility. You'll need to scale the tower, beat back the mercs, and save the day in this follow-up to Rogue City that harks back to the chaotic fun of 80s action movies.  [/p][p]It's been a wild ride to get here and we wouldn't have been able to pour so much love into Unfinished Business without the support of our fans! Thank you so much, and welcome back to Old Detroit! [/p][previewyoutube="NsZxnR-EM6c;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Unfinished Business Launch Timing & Just What Is A Standalone Anyway?
notes.notes:
[p]Reach down for your holster and spin your Auto-9 cause RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business launches tomorrow, July 17th. We're excited to welcome you back to Old Detroit, but some of you may have questions ahead of launch. Let's dive in, shall we?[/p][h2]What is a Standalone?[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/9b26b4900501e1138dbf3dadc15e9f5e528847be.png"][/img]
This standalone follows on from Rogue City, it's not required to have played it, but Unfinished Business does make use of the systems created for Rogue City.  [/p][p]We've expanded on these for Unfinished Business, with new weapons, enemies, environments, and a brand new storyline. All of this takes place in the OmniTower, a housing project turned death trap, that players will navigate on their way to the top. That's the only way to stop the mercenaries gaining access to all OCP technology, RoboCop included.[/p][p]Opting for a standalone also meant that we could expand the scope on what would be a traditional DLC, introducing new gameplay experiences: like playing as Alex Murphy back when he was a beat cop, or causing chaos as ED-209. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/ebbd4d39d60dba2abaad25f41437a8f9e3effc7b.gif"][/img][/p][p]As huge fans of RoboCop, Unfinished Business gave us the option to expand on the universe, revealing more backstory about Murphy's life before he became RoboCop, and solidifying the place of Rogue City between RoboCop 2 and RoboCop 3. We hope fans enjoy playing these moments as much as we did crafting them. [/p][p]Lastly, like the title suggests, Unfinished Business can stand alone, meaning you don't need to own Unfinished Business on the same platform as Rogue City, or even own Rogue City to play Unfinished Business. [/p][h2]What time does RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business launch?[/h2][list][*][p]9:00 PDT (Pacific Daylight Time)[/p][/*][*][p]12:00 EDT (Eastern Daylight Time)[/p][/*][*][p]17:00 BST (British Summer Time)[/p][/*][*][p]18:00 CEST (Central European Summer Time)[/p][/*][/list][p]That means it's your last chance to drop a pre-order and secure yourself the Prime Directives Pack which features a cosmetic skin for when you're playing as RoboCop, Alex Murphy, or using the Cryo Cannon. [/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/9b4e3314cd213c83f2feb029fb2de4abc851b286.jpg"][/img][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527760/RoboCop_Rogue_City__Unfinished_Business/"][/dynamiclink]GeForce Now[/h2][p]As another note, buyers of RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business will be able to play via cloud gaming on GeForce Now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/b420a3708a7809cb8f85399190093b92010e9cf5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Face new foes and scale the OmniTower on July 17th
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/f03f0f9e1387baad1c6965eb17378c3a67ccb22d.png"][/img]
Looming in the distance, the silhouette of the OmniTower watches over Old Detroit. A beacon of the future that OCP envisions, Delta City, a safe, harmonious city overseen by OCP and its subdivisions. A haven protected by ED-209s, RoboCop, and the Detroit Police Department.[/p][p]The OmniTower is the first part of that plan, a housing complex designed to house the residents of Old Detroit during redevelopment, but that vision of a ‘perfect’ future for Delta City is under threat. The OmniTower has been sieged by a group of highly trained mercenaries looking to take control of OCP’s technology and use it for their own goals.[/p][p]That includes RoboCop, and that’s going to be a problem. Following an attack on the Metro West Precinct, RoboCop makes his way to the OmniTower to find that it’s been turned into a fortress, a mix of traps, turrets, and troops designed to keep RoboCop and everyone else at arm’s length.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/d0b49569c77bf80a5088516bf82a0b7548da57af.gif"][/img][/p][p]Flying drones rain bullets down from above, reducing options for cover in open spaces, while other drones act more like mines, waiting for someone to walk past before springing to life and running them down with explosive results. Thank God for the Kevlar laminated into that titanium; you’re going to need it.[/p][p]Especially when the bullets start flying, these mercenaries are kitted out to the teeth, and they’re the shoot first, then shoot again type. Avoid the spray and pray of miniguns, the sub-zero temperatures of the Cryo Cannon, and then take these weapons, turning them against your enemies. Or just keep exclusively using the Auto-9 (we know you’re going to).
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/cbb65e32100a03a4c7e4436130011cc9dc94f95c.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also had reports of men with jetpacks, and some metallic psychopaths running around carrying katanas. We’ve checked the OCP records but have no information on these assailants. To deal with these unknown threats, ED-209 usage has been authorized. 

Well, authorized is a loose word, but it was enough for Miranda Hale, who managed to hack into the control systems for the ED-209. Enforce order with an arsenal of automatic cannons, shotguns, and rocket launchers. After all, it’s easy to keep peace when you leave your enemies in pieces.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/ebbd4d39d60dba2abaad25f41437a8f9e3effc7b.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Take on the OmniTower when RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business drops on July 17th. Pre-purchase and you’ll receive the Prime Directives Pack. [b]You have 20 seconds to comply![/b]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/9b4e3314cd213c83f2feb029fb2de4abc851b286.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527760/RoboCop_Rogue_City__Unfinished_Business/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Everything you need to know about RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/91640f19fddabb5e0c140bce44814f3cdba1586c.png"][/img][/p][p]We're only 2 short weeks away from the launch of RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business and we hope you've excited to take on the OmniTower in this action packed standalone on July 17th.  Part of the joy of working on a RoboCop game is creating what feels like a playable movie; with all the satire, one-liners, and the over-the-top violence that you would expect.

notes.title: Robocop Rogue City Unfinished Business is a leaner, meaner sequel to an FPS gem
notes.notes:
Robocop: Rogue City knew exactly what it was. Teyon's Robocop game perfectly transplanted the '80s action star into the virtual mean streets of Detroit. He was slow, strong, and willing to turn anyone breaking the law into red mist on the wind. After heading to Paris and spending some time with its sequel, Robocop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business, I'm happy to report that it's a leaner and more mechanically diverse experience.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Getting physical in RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/2da06d3313686b8594fb8998c4e16e66890c4487.png[/img]

Unfinished Business is built on the foundations of Rogue City, but returning for the standalone follow-up lets us build on the fantasy of being RoboCop in new and exciting ways. Through story and gameplay, we want you to feel like you’re welded into that powerful metal suit and have the power to match. That’s why we’ve made a few upgrades to give you more tools as you ascend the OmniTower. 

Remember how I talked about being welded into the metal suit? I was being facetious, but metaphorically speaking, a lot of you did step into that role, lifting punks into the air and letting gravity or the environment do the rest of the job. We’ve expanded on that in Unfinished Business by adding a suite of powerful finishing moves: leave someone shocked by planting them in a fuse box, or keep them hydrated by crushing them in the nearest soda machine. There are a lot of unique interactions to be discovered, and we can’t wait to see your favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/7bd8f8e8e2d732a0aa03537c94ac1df2c7a0935a.gif[/img]

There are also new tools to up your firepower. The Cryo Cannon is an absolute powerhouse, one that turns on the tundra, and when you shout freeze, you mean it. Be careful to avoid shattering your new ice sculptures, or don’t, we’re not your boss. 

You can also make use of the tools that the enemies brought to the party, Riot Shields, Katanas, mounted guns, if it’s there, it’s up for grabs. These mercs are armed to the teeth and anything you find is free to use. If the enemy is going to turn the OmniTower into a fortress, then do what needs to be done to make your way to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/d0b49569c77bf80a5088516bf82a0b7548da57af.gif[/img]

There’ll also be gameplay sections taking place outside the tower. These vignettes reveal more about the story, with unique premises and goals. In one, you’ll be playing as Alex Murphy back during his days as a cop on the beat. With only your sense of justice as a shield, you’ll find the gameplay during these sections more focused on dipping in and out of cover, picking the right moment to make your shots. There are several other unique scenes to be discovered throughout your climb through the OmniTower. 

We hope you’re excited to unravel these secrets and more as you tackle the OmniTower when RoboCop: Rogue City launches July 17th. Prepurchase now to receive the Prime Directives Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/9b4e3314cd213c83f2feb029fb2de4abc851b286.jpg[/img]

notes.title: RoboCop: Rogue City Story Trailer & Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/7e51df6e7511edcb8d1813d699ceb7c95cc206b6.png[/img]

Welcome back to Old Detroit,

Unfinished Business picks up where Rogue City left off. While RoboCop continues policing the streets, OCP are working on a new project, the OmniTower, a housing complex designed for the residents evicted from their homes as the corporation proceeds to make way for Delta City.

A group of mercenaries tears into the Metro West precinct, leaving after stealing components from RoboCop's medical chair. Their next target, the OmniTower. The tower can serve as a potential power source, which, combined with those stolen components, would give the mercenaries access to all OCP's technology, including RoboCop.

Pulling off this plan will take time, so they've seized control of the tower, turning each floor into a dangerous maze of enemies, traps, and bullets that you'll have to contend with if you want to retain control of yourself.

As you ascend the tower, ghosts from Alex Murphy’s past will come back to haunt him. The leader of the mercenaries is a former colleague of Murphy. These two's goals are the same, protecting Old Detroit, but their motives differ. 

Uncover these motives on July 17th in RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business. Wishlist for a reminder on release!

notes.title: What is RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business?
notes.notes:
A notice to all residents of Old Detroit,

Welcome to the Omni Tower! 

[previewyoutube=HZxqWFQI7GY;full][/previewyoutube]
Following the announcement of Robocop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business, we’ve had some questions about the term standalone and what that means for Unfinished Business.

To start with, as the word standalone implies, Unfinished Business can be played without needing to own RoboCop: Rogue City. This way, players aren’t forced to own Rogue City if they want to play Unfinished Business, or if preferred, you can pick up the standalone on a different platform to which you own Rogue City. 

And while Unfinished Business is a sequel to Rogue City, it’s not necessary to have played the original to enjoy the latter. Ultimately, this gives players the option to decide what they want with their purchase. In that case, you might be asking why we’re still using Rogue City in the title. That’s because we’re still using a lot of the same systems present in the original game. Things like the UI, progression, and other systems will feel similar. That’s why we’re not calling it Rogue City 2 or calling it a direct sequel. 

Of course, there are new things to be experienced in Unfinished Business. There’s a new storyline with new compelling characters to discover, new weapons, new enemies, devastating finishing moves, and a new setting, the Omni Tower, ascending each layer of a tower turned into a death trap. You’ll also be able to play Alex Murphy before the events of the first film, uncovering more of his past before he became the iconic RoboCop. And that’s not all, but we'll keep some bullets in our Auto-9 for later.
